instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sections.section_title: Q.1 Answer any seven of the following as directed :

questions.text:
Write antonym of the following words by adding suitable prefixes :
(i) Rational
(ii) Intelligible
(iii) Toxic
(iv) Pious

Match the words in Column-A with their meanings in Column-B :
Column-A:
(i) Feasibility
(ii) Option
(iii) Deplete
(iv) Constructive
Column-B:
(1) Exhaust
(2) Productive
(3) Choice
(4) Possibility

Frame sentences using the following phrases :
(i) Switch over
(ii) Gone down

Fill in the blanks with suitable preposition :
Students ______ engineering are provided ______ opportunities ______ get practically trained ______ industries/workshops while doing their courses.

Fill in the blanks with appropriate form of verbs :
(i) Neither of the combatants ______ (was/were) able to break the record.
(ii) Everyone of the labourers ______ (is/are) given a reward.

Fill in the blanks by using the correct form of word given in brackets that agrees with the subject :
Once upon a time, a little orphan boy ______ (live) with his relatives who ______ (treat) him harshly. ______ (fright) that he ______ (punish) severely he ______ (escape).

Fill in the blanks with suitable article :
Just imagine ______ biology teacher explaining ______ respiratory system or just ______ body part like ______ larynx, to the class.

Fill in the blanks with correct preposition :
(i) I don't care ______ expense; I want the party ______ be a real success.
(ii) You can throw ______ the packet, it's empty.
(iii) He suddenly threw ______ his job and went to Australia.

Fill in the blanks with correct adverb :
(i) Clear ______ your books. I want to set ______ the table for lunch.
(ii) Caesar runs ______ and ______ twists his ankle.

Write the passive form of voice of the following :
(i) John hit the ball.
(ii) God knows all.

Read the passage given below carefully and answer the questions that follow :
Ozone, a molecule made up of three atoms of oxygen, comprises a layer of the atmosphere that absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun, chlorine atoms, mainly from man-made chlorofluorocarbons or CFCs, break apart ozone molecules. Chlorine compounds used in human activities such as electronics, manufacturing and refrigeration are a primary cause of the ozone hole. A large area of intense ozone depletion occurs annually over Antarctica during late August through early October. The hole typically breaks up as ozone levels increase in late November.
(a) State whether the following statements are True or False :
(i) Ozone is helpful in the process of absorbing certain radiation creating bad effect.
(ii) Ozone depletion never takes place in the universe.
(iii) The 1993 Ozone Hole is considered to be the largest as per the world record.
(iv) Dobson units are used for measuring the effects of danger of ozone.
(b) Choose the responses which best reflect the meaning of the text :
(i) Ozone layer is found (1) near the north pole (2) near the south pole (3) as a sheet of the atmosphere (4) at both south pole and north pole
(ii) The ozone molecules break apart due to (1) ultraviolet radiation (2) heat of the sun (3) planetary movements (4) the levels being intermediary
(c) Choose the meaning of the following italicized words as they are used in the text amongst the options below :
(i) Radiation: (1) Gathering (2) Spreading out (3) Accumulating (4) Penetrating
(ii) Depletion: (1) Production (2) Removal (3) Moisturization (4) Reduction
(iii) Decline: (1) Becoming weaker (2) Becoming thicker (3) Becoming stronger (4) Becoming rough
(iv) Altitude: (1) Length (2) Breadth (3) Height (4) Circumference
Write a letter to the Editor of a newspaper expressing your concern about the increase in the number of road accidents.

Write a paragraph of 200 words describing any one of the following :
(a) Uses of Internet
(b) Radar

Transcode the following flow chart into a passage of 150 words :

[FLOW CHART: Cellulose shredded wood -> Pulp -> Dissolved -> Solution of sodium hydroxide (caustic soda) -> Setting bath of dil. sulphuric acid -> Spinneret -> Treads are drawn -> Wound on reel -> Washed -> Dried on roller -> Wound on bobbin]
Describe in two paragraphs (200 words) the advantages and disadvantages of nuclear power as an alternative source of energy. Give a good explanation for its extraordinary behaviour.
Write a press release on the Teacher's Day Celebration in your college.

Write notes on any two of the following in not more than 100 words each :
(a) Root creation
(b) Intonation
(c) Stress
(d) Word-formation
Describe the importance of Interpersonal Communication. Or Write on the role of Information Technology in the present scenario.
